description: Source code implementing TCP server and client functionalities with SSL encryption, including certificate loading, client verification, file transfer, and connection management for the Idm_TCP_apis module.

classes.name: tcp_server_threadargs
classes.description: Structure holding callback, port, and interface info for TCP server thread.

methods.name: init_ctx
methods.description: Initializes SSL context with algorithms and method.

methods.name: load_certificate
methods.description: Loads SSL certificate and private key into SSL context.

methods.name: verify_client
methods.description: Verifies if client MAC and IP match discovered device list.

methods.name: tcp_server_thread
methods.description: Main TCP server loop handling incoming connections, SSL handshake, and message processing.

methods.name: open_remote_connection
methods.description: Starts TCP server thread if not started, then creates and connects a client socket with optional SSL.

methods.name: getFile_to_remote
methods.description: Reads a file and sends its size and content over SSL or socket.

methods.name: sendFile_to_remote
methods.description: Reads a file and sends its size and content to remote over SSL or socket, with output location.

methods.name: send_remote_message
methods.description: Sends a payload message over SSL or socket.
